name: Alpinarium Galtür
kurzbeschreibung: Alpinarium Galtür is an extraordinary museum built directly into an avalanche protection wall, featuring exhibitions, bouldering, and a café.
preis: Adults approx. €11.00; free with Silvretta Card Premium
oeffnungszeiten: Summer and winter seasons Tuesday to Sunday 10:00 to 18:00 (closed Mondays)
beschreibung:
Overview

The architecturally spectacular Alpinarium Galtür is situated at an elevation of 1,584 meters in the upper Paznaun Valley and represents a globally unique documentation and exhibition centre in high-alpine terrain. The striking structure was conceived in the aftermath of the devastating 1999 avalanche disaster and is integrated directly into a monumental, 345-meter-long and 19-meter-high protective avalanche wall shielding the alpine village from natural forces. Under the guiding theme 'Close to the Sky', the Alpinarium poignantly combines remembrance culture with state-of-the-art alpine research, meteorology, glacier science, and regional Rhaeto-Romanic heritage. The permanent and temporary exhibitions retrace centuries of mountain farming resilience and illustrate how humans and nature coexist in harmony in high-altitude environments.

Route & Requirements

The Alpinarium Galtür is designed to be fully barrier-free, featuring wide ramps, modern passenger elevators, and threshold-free pathways that make visits effortless for wheelchair users and families with prams. Touring the museum requires no physical exertion and can be enjoyed in any weather wearing casual everyday attire. A standout feature for active visitors and teenagers is the impressive indoor bouldering and climbing wall constructed directly on the rugged natural stone surface of the massive avalanche defence wall. Here, climbers of all abilities can test their skills on diverse routes under supervision. Interactive media terminals, video installations, and immersive audio stations make the tour an emotional and deeply educational experience for the entire family.

Visit & Arrival

The Alpinarium operates during the summer season from early June to mid-October and in winter from December to April, welcoming guests from Tuesday to Sunday between 10:00 and 18:00 (closed Mondays). Summer guests staying locally enjoy free admission with the Silvretta Card Premium. Motorists travel via the A12 Inntal motorway and S16 expressway to Pians, then follow the B188 Paznauntalstraße past Ischgl to Galtür (free parking available in the village centre). By rail, travel to Landeck-Zams station and take the VVT regional bus operating every half hour directly to Galtür Dorfplatz.

Tips

Step onto the rooftop observation platform atop the colossal barrier wall to take in sweeping views of the village of Galtür and the Silvretta peaks. The on-site 'Gefrorene Wasser' café invites guests to relax on its sunny panoramic terrace with specialty coffees and freshly baked strudels.
